# netbox_fhrp_group_assignment (Data Source)

Assignment of an FHRP group to an interface (ipam.fhrpgroupassignment).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/fhrpgroupassignment/):

> Member device and VM interfaces can be assigned to [FHRP groups](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/fhrpgroup/) to indicate their participation in maintaining a common virtual IP address (VIP). For instance, three interfaces, each belonging to a different router, may each be assigned to the same FHRP group to serve a shared VIP. Each of these assignments would typically receive a different priority.
>
> Interfaces are assigned to FHRP groups under the interface detail view.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignment" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_id` (Number) Id of the FHRP group.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `interface_id` (Number) Id of the interface named by interface_type.
- `interface_type` (String) Type of the interface the group is assigned to, e.g. dcim.interface or virtualization.vminterface.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of this interface within the group (0-255).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)
